notes: limits.LIMITS maps each scope to (limit, window), and is_limited alone reads the limit, so M1 and M5 change the first item of the SIGNIN and DEMO entries; client_key parses REMOTE_ADDR and is used by both views. views._guarded_attempt locks the row (lock returns the effective count), checks is_limited, authenticates and records a failure in one transaction: M2 authenticates first and checks the limit only for a failure, and M4 zeroes the locked row's count with an update on success. M3 reads the first X-Forwarded-For entry, falling back to REMOTE_ADDR, in the one client-key function both views use.
